name: test-ci-hardening
title: Gate: CI Hardening
description: Four GitHub Actions hardening rules as a failing test that names every offending file:line — top-level permissions, third-party actions pinned to a full commit SHA (the tj-actions CVE-2025-30066 class), no pull_request_target, and no attacker-controlled context interpolated into a run: block. Trusted owners and strict mode live in docs/gates.json. Measured before it existed: 0 of 8 workflows on this platform declared top-level permissions and 0 pinned any action by SHA.
